mathematics.assertion_tested: On the input grids, the compact 2D Maxwell electric and summed-flux representations agree in partition function, metric stress and theta susceptibility; independent finite differences verify area, theta and coupling derivatives. Normalized Haar integration checks sphere gluing. The 4D six-flux sum obeys the independently varied metric tensor, zero Euclidean trace, exact cubic-torus stress cancellation, inverse-fourth-length scaling and explicit coupling derivatives. Two precisions agree.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Real positive gauge coupling and area; theta periodic modulo 2pi. Analytic formulas use real/complex numbers, numerical checks use mpmath arbitrary precision.
mathematics.conventions: 2D action (2 e2)^-1 integral F wedge star F - i theta/(2pi) integral F; u=e2 A/2; F has integral periods 2pi. Haar-normalized heat-kernel measure. 4D same Maxwell normalization, theta4=0, all six integer fluxes on T4; ratio to zero-bundle partition, beta=rL, alpha_M=e4^2/(4pi). Metric observables differentiate logZ, not logZ/V. Natural units.
inputs: inputs.json specifies 7 positive u values and 5 theta/(2pi) values (35 cases), 6 sphere H/e values, and 4 alpha_M values times 3 aspect ratios (12 cases).
No observational masses, dark energy, Hubble data or target-alpha calibration are inputs.
non_claims: No 4D QCD coefficient, proton mass, QCD+QED response, physical alpha matching or alpha root is computed.
The sphere result is Euclidean and is not by itself a Lorentzian state construction.
The 4D observable is the all-bundles versus zero-bundle difference; the photon oscillator vacuum is not included in that ratio.
Floating-point checks plus analytic truncation bounds are not a certified interval proof.
The exact asymptotic zero-linear-H result follows from the analytic formulas and bounds in REPORT.md, not from the finite grid alone.
